panels.title: SERVICES · Prometheus scrape (up)
panels.description: One cell per Prometheus scrape job (prometheus.yml): UP = the last scrape succeeded (green only then), DOWN = the scrape failed, NO DATA = the job is not reporting. Postgres, Redis and Unsloth are not scraped jobs.

panels.title: FRESHNESS
panels.description: Age of the newest SpendLogs row and of Prometheus' newest LiteLLM scrape. SpendLogs ages during idle periods too, so a large value means stale only when traffic is expected (amber past 6 h). Prometheus scrapes every 15 s; anything over a minute means scraping stopped. Separate from IDLE (no requests).

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - max("startTime")))::int AS "SpendLogs" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE "startTime" > NOW() - interval '30 days'

panels.title: SERVICE
panels.description: Answered ÷ routed requests in the window. Routed = answered + failed after routing; requests the proxy refused at the door (auth, allowlist, rate, budget) are NOT failures of the service and are counted on REJECTED. Source: SpendLogs, one row per request (retries stay inside the row), management routes and Jev's internal classifier calls excluded. Green only at ≥ 99 % with at least one routed request; idle shows grey. Filters: traffic · key · model · team.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success' OR (status = 'failure' AND NOT (status = 'failure' AND (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') IN ('KeyNotFoundError','ModelAccessDeniedProxyException','ProxyRateLimitError','BudgetExceededError','AuthenticationError') OR (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') = 'ProxyException' AND COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code','') IN ('401','403','429')) OR COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','') LIKE 'No api key passed in%')))), 0), 1) AS "answered", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success' OR (status = 'failure' AND NOT (status = 'failure' AND (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') IN ('KeyNotFoundError','ModelAccessDeniedProxyException','ProxyRateLimitError','BudgetExceededError','AuthenticationError') OR (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') = 'ProxyException' AND COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code','') IN ('401','403','429')) OR COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','') LIKE 'No api key passed in%')))) AS "routed" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(call_type,'') !~ '^/' AND COALESCE(call_type,'') <> 'adecisions' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$'))

panels.title: REJECTED
panels.description: Requests the proxy refused before routing: 401 unknown/missing key, 403 allowlist (ModelAccessDenied), 429 rate limit, budget exceeded. Not a provider or service failure; amber because a client is misconfigured or a probe is untagged. Details on the issues list. Source: SpendLogs, window, filters apply.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'failure' AND (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') IN ('KeyNotFoundError','ModelAccessDeniedProxyException','ProxyRateLimitError','BudgetExceededError','AuthenticationError') OR (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') = 'ProxyException' AND COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code','') IN ('401','403','429')) OR COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','') LIKE 'No api key passed in%'))) AS "rejected", count(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias',''),'(no key)')) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'failure' AND (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') IN ('KeyNotFoundError','ModelAccessDeniedProxyException','ProxyRateLimitError','BudgetExceededError','AuthenticationError') OR (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') = 'ProxyException' AND COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code','') IN ('401','403','429')) OR COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','') LIKE 'No api key passed in%'))) AS "sources" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(call_type,'') !~ '^/' AND COALESCE(call_type,'') <> 'adecisions' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$'))

panels.title: FALLBACK
panels.description: Answered requests that a fallback rung served instead of the model asked for (attempted_fallbacks > 0, or the served group differs from original_model_group): the silent model swap a drained provider balance causes. Green = verified zero with traffic; idle = no answered requests. Source: SpendLogs, window, filters apply.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') = 0 THEN NULL ELSE count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success' AND (COALESCE((metadata->>'attempted_fallbacks')::int, 0) > 0 OR (metadata->>'original_model_group' IS NOT NULL AND metadata->>'original_model_group' <> model_group))) END AS "fallback", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success' AND (COALESCE((metadata->>'attempted_fallbacks')::int, 0) > 0 OR (metadata->>'original_model_group' IS NOT NULL AND metadata->>'original_model_group' <> model_group))) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success'), 0), 1) AS "share %" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(call_type,'') !~ '^/' AND COALESCE(call_type,'') <> 'adecisions' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$'))

panels.title: LATENCY
panels.description: 95th and 50th percentile of request_duration_ms over ANSWERED requests in the whole window (proxy in → last byte out, including retries and fallbacks). Long-reasoning models legitimately take tens of seconds. This is not the Prometheus last-interval P95 (Latency section), which covers only the newest $interval. Source: SpendLogs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY request_duration_ms) / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "p95", round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY request_duration_ms) / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "p50" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(call_type,'') !~ '^/' AND COALESCE(call_type,'') <> 'adecisions' AND status = 'success' AND request_duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$'))

panels.title: MTD $
panels.description: Calendar month to date (UTC), ALL logged proxy traffic (no filters): LiteLLM's estimated cost from its price map for requests that went through the proxy. Not a provider invoice and not your total software spend. Second value: month-end estimate = MTD + (last 7 days' spend ÷ 7) × days left in the month; a straight line at the current weekly pace, not a forecast (one heavy day moves it for a week). Both values are amber from $32 (80 % of plan) and red from $40. The plan is a watch line (the alert fires at 80 % of it month to date); the team hard stops in LiteLLM are the refusal boundary.

targets.rawSql: WITH m AS (SELECT COALESCE(sum(spend) FILTER (WHERE "startTime" >= date_trunc('month', NOW())), 0) AS mtd, COALESCE(sum(spend) FILTER (WHERE "startTime" >= NOW() - interval '7 days'), 0) / 7.0 AS per_day, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date_trunc('month', NOW()) + interval '1 month' - NOW())) / 86400.0 AS days_left FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE "startTime" >= LEAST(date_trunc('month', NOW()), NOW() - interval '7 days')) SELECT round(mtd::numeric, 2) AS "logged estimate", round((mtd + per_day * days_left)::numeric, 2) AS "month-end est. · plan $40" FROM m

panels.title: WINDOW $
panels.description: Estimated cost of logged proxy requests in the selected window (LiteLLM price map), filters apply; includes Jev's classifier sub-calls, which cost money but are not requests. Source: SpendLogs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(COALESCE(sum(spend), 0)::numeric, 2) AS "logged estimate", count(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(call_type,'') !~ '^/' AND COALESCE(call_type,'') <> 'adecisions') AS "requests" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$'))

panels.title: LOCAL
panels.description: Answered requests served by a local deployment (Unsloth Desktop :8888 behind unsloth_guard, or the praxen-embed container) ÷ all answered requests in the window. Informational, not a health signal. Source: SpendLogs api_base.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success' AND (COALESCE(api_base,'') LIKE '%:8888%' OR COALESCE(api_base,'') LIKE '%praxen-embed%')) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success'), 0), 1) AS "local", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success' AND (COALESCE(api_base,'') LIKE '%:8888%' OR COALESCE(api_base,'') LIKE '%praxen-embed%')) AS "local answered" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(call_type,'') !~ '^/' AND COALESCE(call_type,'') <> 'adecisions' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$'))

panels.title: ALERTS
panels.description: Grafana unified-alerting instances that are alerting, in error or nodata (live Grafana's own metrics, scraped by Prometheus), out of all rule instances: one spend watch per API key and one for the monthly total. Each sends one email. Watch lines warn; they never block.

panels.title: NEEDS ATTENTION · window · by severity, newest first
panels.description: Every check runs on SpendLogs over the window with the filters applied; the keys-past-watch check is month to date, sums spend by key alias like the alert, and ignores the MODEL filter (a watch line covers the whole key). Severity: BROKEN = failed after routing or out of credit; LOOK = rejected, answered by fallback, off-tier billing or a key past its watch line; INFO = unauthenticated management calls, except keyless model listings (some clients list models without a key by design; the proxy refuses them and they cost nothing). When nothing matches, one VERIFIED row says every check ran. Click a row to open FORENSICS with the same window and filters.

targets.rawSql:
WITH f AS (SELECT * FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$'))),
i AS (
  SELECT 1 AS rk, 'BROKEN' AS severity, 'Out of credit · ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(custom_llm_provider,''),'?') AS issue, count(*) AS n, max("startTime") AS last
    FROM f WHERE status = 'failure' AND (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code','') = '402' OR COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') = 'PaymentRequiredError' OR COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','') ILIKE '%credit balance%' OR COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','') ILIKE '%insufficient_quota%') GROUP BY custom_llm_provider
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2, 'BROKEN', 'Failed after routing · ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group,''),'?') || ' · ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class',''),''),'error') || ' ' || COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code',''),
         count(*), max("startTime") FROM f WHERE COALESCE(call_type,'') !~ '^/' AND COALESCE(call_type,'') <> 'adecisions' AND (status = 'failure' AND NOT (status = 'failure' AND (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') IN ('KeyNotFoundError','ModelAccessDeniedProxyException','ProxyRateLimitError','BudgetExceededError','AuthenticationError') OR (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') = 'ProxyException' AND COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code','') IN ('401','403','429')) OR COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','') LIKE 'No api key passed in%'))) AND NOT (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code','') = '402' OR COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') = 'PaymentRequiredError' OR COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','') ILIKE '%credit balance%' OR COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','') ILIKE '%insufficient_quota%') GROUP BY model_group, COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class',''), COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code','')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 3, 'LOOK', 'Answered by fallback · asked ' || COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group', model_group) || ' → served ' || COALESCE(model_group,'?'),
         count(*), max("startTime") FROM f WHERE status = 'success' AND (COALESCE((metadata->>'attempted_fallbacks')::int, 0) > 0 OR (metadata->>'original_model_group' IS NOT NULL AND metadata->>'original_model_group' <> model_group)) GROUP BY 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 4, 'LOOK', 'Rejected · ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias',''),'(no key)') || ' · ' || COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code','') || ' ' || COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','')
         || ' · ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group,''),'-'),
         count(*), max("startTime") FROM f WHERE COALESCE(call_type,'') !~ '^/' AND COALESCE(call_type,'') <> 'adecisions' AND (status = 'failure' AND (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') IN ('KeyNotFoundError','ModelAccessDeniedProxyException','ProxyRateLimitError','BudgetExceededError','AuthenticationError') OR (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') = 'ProxyException' AND COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code','') IN ('401','403','429')) OR COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','') LIKE 'No api key passed in%')) GROUP BY 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 5, 'LOOK', 'Billed off-tier (priority/fast, not opted in) · ' || COALESCE(model,'?'), count(*), max("startTime")
    FROM f WHERE status = 'success' AND metadata->'cost_breakdown'->>'service_tier' IN ('priority','fast') AND NOT (model_group ~ '-priority$' OR COALESCE(metadata->'routing_decision'->>'routed_model','') ~ '-priority$') GROUP BY model
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 6, 'INFO', 'Unauthenticated management call · ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata->>'user_agent',''),'?') || ' · ' || call_type,
         count(*), max("startTime") FROM f WHERE COALESCE(call_type,'') ~ '^/' AND status = 'failure'
         AND call_type NOT IN ('/models', '/v1/models') GROUP BY 3
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 4, 'LOOK', 'Key past its spend watch (MTD) · ' || w.alias || ' · ' || round(100 * sum(s.spend) / w.line) || '% of $' || round(w.line),
         NULL, max(s."startTime")
    FROM (VALUES ('research-agent', 24.0), ('apps-frontend', 8.0), ('apps-private-lane', 5.0), ('sandbox-probe', 3.0)) AS w(alias, line)
    JOIN "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s ON s.metadata->>'user_api_key_alias' = w.alias AND s."startTime" >= date_trunc('month', NOW())
   WHERE COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$'))
    GROUP BY w.alias, w.line HAVING sum(s.spend) > 0.8 * w.line   -- same as the alert (gt 0.8, spend summed by alias)
)
SELECT severity, issue, "count", "last seen" FROM (
  SELECT rk, severity, issue, n AS "count", last AS "last seen" FROM i
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 9, 'VERIFIED', 'Nothing needs attention: every check ran on this window', 0, NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM i)
) z ORDER BY rk, "last seen" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 12

panels.title: REQUESTS · by outcome
panels.description: Requests per bucket by outcome (SpendLogs, filters apply). Answered = success; rejected = refused at the door; failed = failed after routing. Bucket size follows the window (about 48 bars).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $__interval, 0), count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') AS "answered", count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'failure' AND (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') IN ('KeyNotFoundError','ModelAccessDeniedProxyException','ProxyRateLimitError','BudgetExceededError','AuthenticationError') OR (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') = 'ProxyException' AND COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code','') IN ('401','403','429')) OR COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','') LIKE 'No api key passed in%'))) AS "rejected", count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'failure' AND NOT (status = 'failure' AND (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') IN ('KeyNotFoundError','ModelAccessDeniedProxyException','ProxyRateLimitError','BudgetExceededError','AuthenticationError') OR (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') = 'ProxyException' AND COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code','') IN ('401','403','429')) OR COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','') LIKE 'No api key passed in%')))) AS "failed after routing" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(call_type,'') !~ '^/' AND COALESCE(call_type,'') <> 'adecisions' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: ESTIMATED COST · by provider
panels.description: Logged proxy cost per bucket, stacked by provider (LiteLLM's estimate from its price map; filters apply; not a provider bill). Local deployments cost $0 and do not appear.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $__interval, 0), COALESCE(NULLIF(custom_llm_provider,''),'other') AS metric, round(sum(spend)::numeric, 4) AS value FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND spend > 0 AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$')) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: MODELS & LOCAL TIER · per-model telemetry, Unsloth served ids  (3 panels)
Per-model telemetry // routed · success · fallback · tokens · latency · TTFT · tok/s · cost (SpendLogs, window)
panels.description: One row per model the client ASKED for (original_model_group, else the serving group) over the window, from SpendLogs (one row per request; management routes and Jev's classifier calls excluded; filters apply). Routed = answered + failed after routing (door rejections are on REJECTED). Success = answered ÷ routed. Fallback = answered by another rung. Tokens, p50 / p95 (end-to-end request_duration_ms) and cost cover answered requests; cost is LiteLLM's price-map estimate. TTFT and tok/s use streamed answers only (at least half a second between first token and end; LiteLLM gives a non-streamed answer no separate first-token time), so a model only ever called without streaming shows them blank. Upstream latency and TTFT from Prometheus are in the LATENCY section.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata->>'original_model_group',''), NULLIF(model_group,''), NULLIF(model,''), '?') AS "Model", count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'success' OR (status = 'failure' AND NOT (status = 'failure' AND (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') IN ('KeyNotFoundError','ModelAccessDeniedProxyException','ProxyRateLimitError','BudgetExceededError','AuthenticationError') OR (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') = 'ProxyException' AND COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code','') IN ('401','403','429')) OR COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','') LIKE 'No api key passed in%'))))) AS "Routed", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'success' OR (status = 'failure' AND NOT (status = 'failure' AND (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') IN ('KeyNotFoundError','ModelAccessDeniedProxyException','ProxyRateLimitError','BudgetExceededError','AuthenticationError') OR (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') = 'ProxyException' AND COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code','') IN ('401','403','429')) OR COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','') LIKE 'No api key passed in%'))))), 0), 1) AS "Success", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success' AND (COALESCE((metadata->>'attempted_fallbacks')::int, 0) > 0 OR (metadata->>'original_model_group' IS NOT NULL AND metadata->>'original_model_group' <> model_group))) AS "Fallback", sum(prompt_tokens) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') AS "Input tok", sum(completion_tokens) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') AS "Output tok", round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY request_duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "p50", round((percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY request_duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success') / 1000.0)::numeric, 1) AS "p95", round(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("completionStartTime" - "startTime"))) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success' AND "endTime" - "completionStartTime" >= interval '0.5 seconds')::numeric, 2) AS "TTFT", round((sum(completion_tokens) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success' AND "endTime" - "completionStartTime" >= interval '0.5 seconds') / NULLIF(sum(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "completionStartTime"))) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success' AND "endTime" - "completionStartTime" >= interval '0.5 seconds'), 0))::numeric, 0) AS "tok/s", round(sum(spend)::numeric, 4) AS "Cost" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(call_type,'') !~ '^/' AND COALESCE(call_type,'') <> 'adecisions' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$')) GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'success' OR (status = 'failure' AND NOT (status = 'failure' AND (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') IN ('KeyNotFoundError','ModelAccessDeniedProxyException','ProxyRateLimitError','BudgetExceededError','AuthenticationError') OR (COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_class','') = 'ProxyException' AND COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_code','') IN ('401','403','429')) OR COALESCE(metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','') LIKE 'No api key passed in%'))))) > 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 400

panels.title: COST, TIER & CACHE · cost by model, service tier, prompt cache, advised spend, plan vs hard stops  (9 panels)
SPEND MTD · logged estimate, all traffic
panels.description: Total dollars the proxy has logged since the first of this month, across every key. Amber at $32 (80% of the $40 plan — the point the spend-watch alert fires) and red at $40.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(spend),0) AS "mtd_usd" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE "startTime" >= date_trunc('month', NOW())

panels.title: vs $40 PLAN · vs TEAM HARD STOPS (live Σ max_budget)
panels.description: The same month-to-date spend as two percentages: of the $40 monthly plan (a watch line — nothing is refused) and of the team hard stops added together, read live from the proxy database (the point where requests WOULD be refused). The separate global cap in litellm_settings is a last-resort backstop only.

targets.rawSql: WITH m AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(spend),0) AS mtd FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE "startTime" >= date_trunc('month', NOW())), t AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(max_budget),0) AS hard_stop FROM "LiteLLM_TeamTable" WHERE max_budget IS NOT NULL AND max_budget > 0) SELECT 'PLAN $40' AS "limit", ROUND((100 * m.mtd / 40.0)::numeric, 1) AS "pct" FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 'TEAM HARD STOPS $' || ROUND(t.hard_stop)::text || ' (live)', ROUND((100 * m.mtd / NULLIF(t.hard_stop, 0))::numeric, 1) FROM m, t

panels.title: OFF-TIER SHARE
panels.description: Percentage of successful calls that were billed at a premium speed tier without being asked for (same rule as the OFF-TIER CALLS tile: named -priority routes and router-chosen premium lanes count as opt-in). Respects the TRAFFIC, KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top (TRAFFIC = clients leaves out the health check's own test calls).

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE metadata->'cost_breakdown'->>'service_tier' IN ('priority','fast') AND NOT (model_group ~ '-priority$' OR COALESCE(metadata->'routing_decision'->>'routed_model','') ~ '-priority$')) / NULLIF(count(*), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "off_tier_pct" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND status = 'success' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$'))

panels.title: OFF-TIER CALLS
panels.description: Calls billed at a premium speed tier (priority or fast) that nobody asked for. Choosing a route whose name ends in -priority, or the router picking one on purpose, counts as opt-in and is excluded. Green at 0; anything else means you paid a multiplier you did not choose. Respects the TRAFFIC, KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top (TRAFFIC = clients leaves out the health check's own test calls).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "off_tier_calls" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND metadata->'cost_breakdown'->>'service_tier' IN ('priority','fast') AND NOT (model_group ~ '-priority$' OR COALESCE(metadata->'routing_decision'->>'routed_model','') ~ '-priority$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$'))

panels.title: CACHE READ RATIO
panels.description: How much of the prompt text the providers served from their prompt caches instead of re-processing it, as a share of all prompt tokens. Higher is cheaper. Respects the TRAFFIC, KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top (TRAFFIC = clients leaves out the health check's own test calls).

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((100.0 * sum(COALESCE((metadata->'usage_object'->'prompt_tokens_details'->>'cached_tokens')::bigint, (metadata->'usage_object'->>'cache_read_input_tokens')::bigint, 0)) / NULLIF(sum(prompt_tokens), 0))::numeric, 1) AS "cache_read_pct" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND status = 'success' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$'))

panels.title: Cost by model // spend (range)
panels.description: Dollars spent per model over the range, largest first, from the proxy's live counters (these restart with the proxy; the request log on FORENSICS is the ledger). Respects the TRAFFIC, KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top (TRAFFIC = clients leaves out the health check's own test calls).

panels.title: Service tier truth // route · billed tier · x vs standard rate (range)
panels.description: Which speed tier each route was actually billed at, and what that cost compared with the standard rate for the same tokens. 'opt-in lane' means the premium was chosen on purpose (a -priority route, or the router choosing one); 'OFF-TIER' means it was not. A 'priority' row at 1.00x means the vendor was asked for priority but did not apply it. Respects the TRAFFIC, KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top (TRAFFIC = clients leaves out the health check's own test calls).

targets.rawSql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT
    model_group,
    custom_llm_provider AS provider,
    COALESCE(metadata->'routing_decision'->>'routed_model','') AS routed_model,
    metadata->'cost_breakdown'->>'service_tier' AS tier,
    spend,
    prompt_tokens,
    completion_tokens,
    COALESCE((metadata->'usage_object'->'prompt_tokens_details'->>'cached_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS cached_tok,
    COALESCE((metadata->'usage_object'->'prompt_tokens_details'->>'cache_creation_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS cache_write_tok,
    (metadata->'model_map_information'->'model_map_value'->>'input_cost_per_token')::float AS in_rate,
    (metadata->'model_map_information'->'model_map_value'->>'output_cost_per_token')::float AS out_rate,
    (metadata->'model_map_information'->'model_map_value'->>'cache_read_input_token_cost')::float AS cr_rate,
    (metadata->'model_map_information'->'model_map_value'->>'cache_creation_input_token_cost')::float AS cw_rate,
    "startTime"
  FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
  WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
    AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$'))
    AND metadata->'cost_breakdown'->>'service_tier' IS NOT NULL
),
x AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN in_rate IS NOT NULL AND out_rate IS NOT NULL THEN
      GREATEST(prompt_tokens - cached_tok - cache_write_tok, 0) * in_rate
      + cached_tok * COALESCE(cr_rate, in_rate)
      + cache_write_tok * COALESCE(cw_rate, in_rate)
      + completion_tokens * out_rate
    END AS std_usd
  FROM r
)
SELECT
  model_group AS "route",
  provider,
  tier,
  CASE WHEN tier IN ('priority','fast') AND NOT (model_group ~ '-priority$' OR bool_or(routed_model ~ '-priority$')) THEN 'OFF-TIER ⚠'
       WHEN tier IN ('priority','fast') THEN 'opt-in lane'
       WHEN tier = 'flex' THEN 'discount'
       ELSE 'standard' END AS "verdict",
  count(*) AS "calls",
  sum(prompt_tokens) AS "in_tok",
  sum(completion_tokens) AS "out_tok",
  round(sum(spend)::numeric, 5) AS "billed_usd",
  round(sum(std_usd)::numeric, 5) AS "std_rate_usd",
  round((sum(spend) / NULLIF(sum(std_usd), 0))::numeric, 2) AS "x_vs_standard",
  max("startTime") AS "last_seen"
FROM x
GROUP BY model_group, provider, tier
ORDER BY (tier IN ('priority','fast') AND NOT (model_group ~ '-priority$' OR bool_or(routed_model ~ '-priority$'))) DESC, "x_vs_standard" DESC NULLS LAST, sum(spend) DESC

panels.title: Prompt cache // reads · writes · read ratio · est. $ saved (range)
panels.description: Per model: how many calls hit the prompt cache, tokens read from and written to it, the read share, and an estimated dollar saving worked out from the price the proxy recorded on each call. Models with no cache activity are hidden. Respects the TRAFFIC, KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top (TRAFFIC = clients leaves out the health check's own test calls).

targets.rawSql: WITH r AS (SELECT model, prompt_tokens, COALESCE((metadata->'usage_object'->'prompt_tokens_details'->>'cached_tokens')::bigint, (metadata->'usage_object'->>'cache_read_input_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS read_tok, COALESCE((metadata->'usage_object'->'prompt_tokens_details'->>'cache_creation_tokens')::bigint, (metadata->'usage_object'->>'cache_creation_input_tokens')::bigint, 0) AS write_tok, (metadata->'model_map_information'->'model_map_value'->>'input_cost_per_token')::float AS in_rate, (metadata->'model_map_information'->'model_map_value'->>'cache_read_input_token_cost')::float AS cr_rate FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$'))) SELECT model, count(*) AS calls, count(*) FILTER (WHERE read_tok > 0) AS cache_hits, sum(read_tok) AS read_tok, sum(write_tok) AS write_tok, round((100.0 * sum(read_tok) / NULLIF(sum(prompt_tokens), 0))::numeric, 1) AS read_ratio_pct, round(sum(read_tok * (in_rate - COALESCE(cr_rate, in_rate)))::numeric, 4) AS est_usd_saved FROM r GROUP BY model HAVING sum(read_tok) > 0 OR sum(write_tok) > 0 ORDER BY sum(read_tok) DESC

panels.title: Advised routes // spend by route · logged at executor rate (⚠ advisor premium under-counted)
panels.description: Spend on the advised routes (where a second, stronger model advises the answering model). The proxy logs the advisor's tokens at the cheaper answering model's rate, so the real bill is higher than shown. Respects the TRAFFIC, KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top (TRAFFIC = clients leaves out the health check's own test calls).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  model_group AS "route",
  count(*) AS "calls",
  sum(prompt_tokens) AS "in_tok",
  sum(completion_tokens) AS "out_tok",
  round(sum(spend)::numeric, 4) AS "logged_usd_exec_rate",
  round((sum(spend) / NULLIF(count(*),0))::numeric, 5) AS "avg_usd_call"
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$')) AND model_group ~ '-advised'
GROUP BY model_group
ORDER BY sum(spend) DESC

panels.title: JEV · ACTED — decisions that changed routing  (6 panels)
ACTED · ROUTER DECISIONS // router · tier · cause → routed · served (SpendLogs)
panels.description: One row per router, tier, cause and routed model in the range, from the decision every complexity router writes on the request's log row. cause classifier_plugin = Jev (or OpenAI Decisions on the OpenAI routers) picked the tier; default_model_fallback = the classifier declined (on the lane routers array/reasoning, array/fast and array/coding: the kill switch, a lane switched off, Jev unavailable, or a call with no user text) and the router's default model, the lane's old primary, answered — no tier is recorded then. routed = the tier model the router chose; served = the model that actually answered (a backup model in the lane's chain when the tier model failed; fallback counts those). usd and micro_usd_per_call compare what each tier costs per request, which is how to tell whether routing a lane's easy prompts down is saving money. Respects the TRAFFIC, KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top (TRAFFIC = clients leaves out the health check's own test calls).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(metadata->'routing_decision'->>'router_model_name', metadata->>'original_model_group', model_group) AS router, COALESCE(metadata->'routing_decision'->>'tier', '(none)') AS tier, COALESCE(metadata->'routing_decision'->>'cause', '?') AS cause, COALESCE(metadata->'routing_decision'->>'routed_model', '-') AS routed_model, string_agg(DISTINCT regexp_replace(COALESCE(model, '-'), '^.*/', ''), ', ') AS served, count(*) AS calls, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failure') AS failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success' AND (COALESCE((metadata->>'attempted_fallbacks')::int, 0) > 0 OR (metadata->>'original_model_group' IS NOT NULL AND metadata->>'original_model_group' <> model_group))) AS fallback, round(sum(spend)::numeric, 4) AS usd, round((1e6 * avg(spend))::numeric, 1) AS micro_usd_per_call, round(avg(prompt_tokens)) AS avg_in, round(avg(completion_tokens)) AS avg_out, max("startTime") AS last_seen FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(call_type, '') <> 'adecisions' AND jsonb_typeof(metadata->'routing_decision') = 'object' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$')) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY 1, array_position(ARRAY['SIMPLE','MEDIUM','COMPLEX','REASONING','(none)'], COALESCE(metadata->'routing_decision'->>'tier', '(none)')), calls DESC

panels.title: ACTED · REFUSALS CAUGHT %
panels.description: Of the non-streamed answers the Jev judge checked on routes that CAN fall back (the routes with a refusal fallback chain), the share it flagged as a refusal or an empty non-answer and sent on to the next model. Streamed answers, and answers from first-party or local models that have no chain, are only recorded (OBSERVE-ONLY JUDGE below) and are left out of this share.

targets.expr: (sum((increase(praxen_jev_judge_verdict_total{action="fallback"}[$__range]) + (min_over_time(praxen_jev_judge_verdict_total{action="fallback"}[$__range]) unless praxen_jev_judge_verdict_total{action="fallback"} offset $__range)) or increase(praxen_jev_judge_verdict_total{action="fallback"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum((increase(praxen_jev_judge_verdict_total{action!="observed"}[$__range]) + (min_over_time(praxen_jev_judge_verdict_total{action!="observed"}[$__range]) unless praxen_jev_judge_verdict_total{action!="observed"} offset $__range)) or increase(praxen_jev_judge_verdict_total{action!="observed"}[$__range])), 1)

panels.title: ACTED · SOFT REFUSALS
panels.description: Answers the Jev judge flagged as a refusal or as an empty non-answer, which then fell back to the next model.

panels.title: ACTED · LOCAL FRONT
panels.description: What Jev did with direct calls to a local model in the range: ESCALATED = moved up to a stronger local model because the prompt needed it; KEPT = the model asked for was strong enough (or is call-by-name only); BLOCKED = a stronger model was needed but none could take it (no vision, too small a context window, censored, outside the key's allowlist); BYPASSED = not acted on (Jev unavailable, the caller opted out, a local model Jev has no facts for, or an error). ESCALATION % = escalated out of all checked calls. Calls never go down and are always answered on the PC, but the prompt itself goes to api.typesafe.ai for the check (a caller opts out with metadata jev_skip).

targets.expr: 100 * (sum((increase(praxen_jev_local_front_total{outcome="escalated"}[$__range]) + (min_over_time(praxen_jev_local_front_total{outcome="escalated"}[$__range]) unless praxen_jev_local_front_total{outcome="escalated"} offset $__range)) or increase(praxen_jev_local_front_total{outcome="escalated"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum((increase(praxen_jev_local_front_total{outcome=~"escalated|kept|kept_gated|blocked_.*"}[$__range]) + (min_over_time(praxen_jev_local_front_total{outcome=~"escalated|kept|kept_gated|blocked_.*"}[$__range]) unless praxen_jev_local_front_total{outcome=~"escalated|kept|kept_gated|blocked_.*"} offset $__range)) or increase(praxen_jev_local_front_total{outcome=~"escalated|kept|kept_gated|blocked_.*"}[$__range])) or vector(0), 1)

panels.title: ACTED · LOCAL FRONT // requested → served · outcome
panels.description: One row per direct local call path in the range: the local model the client asked for, the one that actually answered, and why (escalated, kept, kept_gated, blocked_<reason>, opted_out, declined, unknown_model, error).

targets.expr: sum by (requested, served, outcome) ((increase(praxen_jev_local_front_total[$__range]) + (min_over_time(praxen_jev_local_front_total[$__range]) unless praxen_jev_local_front_total offset $__range)) or increase(praxen_jev_local_front_total[$__range]))

panels.title: JUDGE VERDICTS // group · verdict · action (action=fallback acted; observed = recorded only)
panels.description: Every judge verdict by route and what happened next: 'fallback' = sent to the next model in the chain, 'pass' = left alone, 'observed' = recorded only (a streamed answer, or a first-party or local model with no refusal fallback). Verdicts: answered, refused, non_answer, plus truncated (the answer hit its length limit — the health gate's one-token probes land here), skipped_long, uncertain, suspicious (an answer that grades itself), capability_refusal and unavailable.

panels.title: JEV · OBSERVE-ONLY — recorded, never re-routed  (6 panels)
OBSERVE-ONLY · JUDGE // verdicts by group, never re-routed
panels.description: Answers that Jev judged but was not allowed to act on, by route: first-party OpenAI, Anthropic and Google models and local models called by name that have no refusal fallback chain (the Claude Fable, Opus, Mythos and Sonnet 5.5 names have one and are judged like any chain route), plus streamed answers on any judged route (already sent, so recorded only). answered is healthy; refused and non_answer are soft refusals, though a fallback fires only at p >= 0.85 (the decision log's would_fallback says which would have); suspicious is an answer that grades itself; truncated is mostly the health gate's one-token probes.

targets.expr: sum by (model_group, verdict) ((increase(praxen_jev_judge_verdict_total{action="observed"}[$__range]) + (min_over_time(praxen_jev_judge_verdict_total{action="observed"}[$__range]) unless praxen_jev_judge_verdict_total{action="observed"} offset $__range)) or increase(praxen_jev_judge_verdict_total{action="observed"}[$__range]))

panels.title: OBSERVE-ONLY · SHADOW CLASSIFIER // tier Jev would pick
panels.description: For prompts sent to the fixed alias lanes (reasoning, fast, coding, vision and the Go lanes) and, since 2026-10-05, to OpenAI, Anthropic and Google models called by name, the tier Jev would have chosen. Nothing is re-routed; this shows whether a lane or model is getting the kind of prompts it is priced for. Since 2026-10-28 array/reasoning, array/fast and array/coding are routers, not fixed lanes, so they appear on ROUTER DECISIONS instead; the bare, praxen/ and go/ names of those lanes are still shadowed here.

panels.title: OBSERVE-ONLY · SHADOW MISMATCH
panels.description: How often a lane or model got the wrong kind of prompt in the range. OVER-PAYING: a reasoning or coding lane, or a premium-priced model ($4 or more per million input tokens), received an easy prompt. UNDER-POWERED: a fast lane, a coding-lite lane or a budget-priced model ($0.30 or less) received a hard one. Models priced in between never count as a mismatch. Recorded only, never acted on.

panels.title: OBSERVE-ONLY · FIRST-PARTY SHADOW // tier · price band · mismatch
panels.description: For OpenAI, Anthropic and Google models called by name: the tier Jev would have picked for each prompt, the model's price band, and the mismatch it implies. Premium models ($4 or more per million input tokens, such as gpt-6-astra) given easy prompts are over-paying; budget models ($0.30 or less, such as gpt-6-luna) given hard ones are under-powered; standard-band models (such as gpt-6-sol and gpt-6.1-sol) and unpriced ones never mismatch. From the proxy's decision log, so it reaches back 7 days at most.

targets.expr: sum by (model_group, band, tier, mismatch) (count_over_time({container="praxen-litellm"} |= "jev_gate {" |= "\"band\": \"price_" | regexp "jev_gate (?P<j>.+)" | line_format "{{.j}}" | json model_group, band, tier, mismatch | label_format mismatch=`{{ if .mismatch }}{{ .mismatch }}{{ else }}none{{ end }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: OBSERVE-ONLY · MATRIX AGREEMENT
panels.description: How often Jev's new local-model picker would have chosen the same local model that actually answered. It is only watching for now and changes nothing. UNGATED leaves out the models still held back for approval; ALL includes them.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum((increase(praxen_jev_local_matrix_total{variant="ungated",agrees="yes"}[$__range]) + (min_over_time(praxen_jev_local_matrix_total{variant="ungated",agrees="yes"}[$__range]) unless praxen_jev_local_matrix_total{variant="ungated",agrees="yes"} offset $__range)) or increase(praxen_jev_local_matrix_total{variant="ungated",agrees="yes"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum((increase(praxen_jev_local_matrix_total{variant="ungated"}[$__range]) + (min_over_time(praxen_jev_local_matrix_total{variant="ungated"}[$__range]) unless praxen_jev_local_matrix_total{variant="ungated"} offset $__range)) or increase(praxen_jev_local_matrix_total{variant="ungated"}[$__range])) or vector(0), 1)

100 * (sum((increase(praxen_jev_local_matrix_total{variant="all",agrees="yes"}[$__range]) + (min_over_time(praxen_jev_local_matrix_total{variant="all",agrees="yes"}[$__range]) unless praxen_jev_local_matrix_total{variant="all",agrees="yes"} offset $__range)) or increase(praxen_jev_local_matrix_total{variant="all",agrees="yes"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum((increase(praxen_jev_local_matrix_total{variant="all"}[$__range]) + (min_over_time(praxen_jev_local_matrix_total{variant="all"}[$__range]) unless praxen_jev_local_matrix_total{variant="all"} offset $__range)) or increase(praxen_jev_local_matrix_total{variant="all"}[$__range])) or vector(0), 1)

panels.title: OBSERVE-ONLY · LOCAL MATRIX // would-pick table (record-only)
panels.description: Each choice the local-model picker would have made: where the call came from, how hard Jev judged it, what kind of task it was (general, code, tools or images), the model it would have picked, and whether that matches the model that answered.

targets.expr: sum by (source, tier, task, posture, variant, pick, agrees) ((increase(praxen_jev_local_matrix_total[$__range]) + (min_over_time(praxen_jev_local_matrix_total[$__range]) unless praxen_jev_local_matrix_total offset $__range)) or increase(praxen_jev_local_matrix_total[$__range]))

panels.title: JEV · OPERATIONS — calls, cost, latency, tier mix, policy drift, decision log  (6 panels)
JEV CALLS // classifier · judge · shadow · local front · Decisions · errors (range)
panels.description: How many times the proxy asked Jev for a decision, by use: classifying a prompt for a router (CLASSIFIER), judging an answer (JUDGE), recording the tier it would have picked for a fixed lane or a first-party model (SHADOW), and checking a direct call to a local model (LOCAL FRONT). ERRORS = calls that failed (time-outs, key, circuit-breaker or HTTP errors); SKIPPED = record-only checks dropped by the 120-per-minute caps, which are not errors. When Jev fails, routers fall back to the built-in scorer, answers pass through unjudged and local calls run on the model asked for. DECISIONS = prompts on the OpenAI routers that OpenAI Decisions classified, through LiteLLM (each one is also a priced SpendLogs row billed to the caller's key); DEC FAILED = Decisions calls that timed out, errored or came back unreadable, after which the router used its own heuristic.

targets.expr: sum((increase(praxen_jev_calls_total{purpose="judge"}[$__range]) + (min_over_time(praxen_jev_calls_total{purpose="judge"}[$__range]) unless praxen_jev_calls_total{purpose="judge"} offset $__range)) or increase(praxen_jev_calls_total{purpose="judge"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: JEV EST. SPEND (range)
panels.description: Estimated dollars spent on Jev (TypeSafe) in the range, across all four uses (classifying, judging, shadowing and the local front). Jev bills input tokens only. Not included: the OpenAI Decisions classifier of the OpenAI routers, which since 2026-10-19 is metered by LiteLLM itself (SpendLogs, model jev-decisions) and so already counts in every spend panel and budget.

panels.title: Jev latency p50 / p95 by purpose
panels.description: How long Jev takes to decide — the typical case (p50) and the slow end (p95) — for each use: classifying prompts, judging answers, shadow checks and the local front. The local front's time is added to the direct local call it checks. The decisions lines are the OpenAI Decisions classifier of the OpenAI routers, timed through LiteLLM.

panels.title: Classifier tier mix // by router
panels.description: Which complexity tier Jev assigned, over time, one series per router and tier. array/auto sends SIMPLE to the PC's 3B model, MEDIUM to the cheapest cloud model, COMPLEX and REASONING to the stronger cloud models; the OpenAI routers (array/auto-openai, praxen/openai-router) send SIMPLE and MEDIUM to standard GPT models and COMPLEX and REASONING to the priority lanes; the local routers use local models only; 'local-front' is the tier Jev gave a direct call to a local model. Since 2026-10-28 the lane routers array/reasoning, array/fast and array/coding send SIMPLE and MEDIUM to a cheaper model from their own chain and keep COMPLEX and REASONING (and every image or long conversation) on the lane's old model.

panels.title: JEV POLICY // drift · injection · capability · policy edits (range)
panels.description: Housekeeping counters for the Jev gate: answers from a Jev version other than the pinned one (DRIFT), prompts flagged as trying to steer the router (INJECTION), refusals that were really a missing tool rather than a policy (CAPABILITY), and verdicts the router policy adjusted (POLICY: uncertain promotion, injection guard, size floor and, since 2026-10-28, the image floor and tier clamps of the lane routers).

panels.title: Jev decisions // JSON events (classifier · judge · shadow · local front · errors)
panels.description: The raw Jev decision events from the proxy log, newest first, one JSON line each: classifier, judge, shadow and local-front decisions and Jev errors.

panels.title: CLIENTS · key lanes: who used the gateway, against which watch line  (1 panel)
Key lanes // last seen · calls (range) · MTD $ · watch line · hard cap
panels.description: One row per API key: when it was last used, calls in the range, dollars this month, its share of the $40 plan (the watch line) and how far along it is, and its hard cap. Watch lines warn; hard caps refuse.

targets.rawSql: WITH watch(alias, line) AS (VALUES ('research-agent', 24.0), ('apps-frontend', 8.0), ('apps-private-lane', 5.0), ('sandbox-probe', 3.0)) SELECT v.key_alias AS "key", COALESCE(v.team_id,'-') AS team, MAX(s."startTime") AS last_seen, COUNT(s.request_id) FILTER (WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime")) AS calls_range, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(s.spend) FILTER (WHERE s."startTime" >= date_trunc('month', NOW())), 0)::numeric, 4) AS mtd_usd, w.line AS watch_line_usd, ROUND((100 * COALESCE(SUM(s.spend) FILTER (WHERE s."startTime" >= date_trunc('month', NOW())), 0) / NULLIF(w.line, 0))::numeric, 1) AS watch_pct, v.max_budget AS hard_cap_usd, ROUND((100 * COALESCE(v.spend, 0) / NULLIF(v.max_budget, 0))::numeric, 1) AS cap_pct FROM "LiteLLM_VerificationToken" v LEFT JOIN watch w ON w.alias = v.key_alias LEFT JOIN "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s ON s.api_key = v.token WHERE COALESCE(v.key_alias,'') <> '' GROUP BY v.key_alias, v.team_id, w.line, v.max_budget, v.spend ORDER BY mtd_usd DESC, v.key_alias

panels.title: TEAMS & ROUTING POSTURE · team envelopes, rung health, legacy tiles  (14 panels)
Team envelope consumed // % of max_budget (live from LiteLLM Postgres)
panels.description: How much of each team's monthly hard stop has been used, from the proxy's own counters. At 100% the team's keys are refused until the monthly reset.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT team_alias AS "team",
       ROUND((100 * spend / NULLIF(max_budget,0))::numeric, 1) AS "pct_consumed"
FROM "LiteLLM_TeamTable"
WHERE max_budget IS NOT NULL AND max_budget > 0
ORDER BY max_budget DESC

panels.title: FALLBACK SHARE // rungs
panels.description: How often a model call failed and the proxy moved on to the next model in its chain, as a share of all model calls in the range. Counted per call, not per request: one request that tried three dead models counts three times (the overview's FALLBACK tile counts requests). Amber past 2%, red past 10%. Respects the TRAFFIC, KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top (TRAFFIC = clients leaves out the health check's own test calls).

panels.title: LOCAL SHARE // success responses (Prometheus, rung level)
panels.description: Share of successful calls answered on this PC (Unsloth Desktop and the praxen-embed container) instead of a cloud provider. Respects the TRAFFIC, KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top (TRAFFIC = clients leaves out the health check's own test calls).

panels.title: ACTIVE WATCHES
panels.description: How many alerts are firing right now, out of all the checks Grafana runs: one spend watch per API key and one for the monthly total. A spend watch warns that a key, or the whole proxy, is past 80% of its share of the monthly plan. Alerts never block anything.

panels.title: REQUEST SUCCESS · all requests incl. rejections (legacy scope)
panels.description: Share of requests that got an answer in the selected time range, one count per request: a request a backup model answered counts as answered. Under 99% deserves a look; under 90% something is failing repeatedly. Respects the TRAFFIC, KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top (TRAFFIC = clients leaves out the health check's own test calls).

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(1 - count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failure')::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 4) AS "success" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$'))

panels.title: ERROR RATE · newest $interval bucket only (legacy scope)
panels.description: Percentage of requests that failed, per INTERVAL. The big number is the latest interval that had traffic; the shaded line is the whole time range. Respects the TRAFFIC, KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top (TRAFFIC = clients leaves out the health check's own test calls).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", '$interval'), round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failure') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "error %" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: SERVED BY FALLBACK
panels.description: Requests in the selected range that the model asked for did not answer: a backup model in its chain did (SERVED), and that count as a share of all requests (SHARE). The client still got an answer, but from a different model, often a different vendor. A provider that runs out of credit shows up here first. Green at 0. Respects the TRAFFIC, KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top (TRAFFIC = clients leaves out the health check's own test calls).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success' AND (COALESCE((metadata->>'attempted_fallbacks')::int, 0) > 0 OR (metadata->>'original_model_group' IS NOT NULL AND metadata->>'original_model_group' <> model_group))) AS "SERVED", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success' AND (COALESCE((metadata->>'attempted_fallbacks')::int, 0) > 0 OR (metadata->>'original_model_group' IS NOT NULL AND metadata->>'original_model_group' <> model_group))) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "SHARE" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$'))

panels.title: Requests & error rate // per $interval
panels.description: Requests per INTERVAL (blue), failed requests (red), requests a backup model answered (amber) and the failure percentage (amber dashes, right-hand axis). Respects the TRAFFIC, KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top (TRAFFIC = clients leaves out the health check's own test calls).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", '$interval', 0), count(*) AS "requests", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failure') AS "failed", count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'success' AND (COALESCE((metadata->>'attempted_fallbacks')::int, 0) > 0 OR (metadata->>'original_model_group' IS NOT NULL AND metadata->>'original_model_group' <> model_group))) AS "served by fallback" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", '$interval'), round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failure') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) AS "error %" FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: The 50 most recent requests in the selected range: which key called, the route it asked for, the model that answered, success or failure, how long it took, tokens, dollars and the billed tier. Click a request id to investigate it on FORENSICS. Respects the TRAFFIC, KEY, MODEL and TEAM pickers at the top (TRAFFIC = clients leaves out the health check's own test calls).

targets.rawSql: SELECT "startTime" AS "time", COALESCE(NULLIF(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias',''),'-') AS key, COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group,''),'-') AS route, COALESCE(NULLIF(model,''),'-') AS model, COALESCE(NULLIF(status,''),'?') AS status, request_duration_ms AS ms, prompt_tokens AS in_tok, completion_tokens AS out_tok, round(spend::numeric,5) AS usd, COALESCE(metadata->'cost_breakdown'->>'service_tier','-') AS tier, request_id FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${key:regex})$' AND (COALESCE(model_group,'') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$' OR COALESCE(metadata->>'original_model_group','') ~ '^(?:${model:regex})$') AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_team_alias','') ~ '^(?:${team:regex})$' AND ('${traffic:raw}' = 'a^' OR NOT (COALESCE(request_tags, '[]'::jsonb) @> '["health-gate"]'::jsonb OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_agent','') LIKE 'praxen-health-gate%' OR (COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') = '' AND COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_user_id','') = 'default_user_id') OR COALESCE(metadata->>'user_api_key_alias','') ~ '^(?:${traffic:raw})$')) ORDER BY "startTime" DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Warn + error // $logcontainer
panels.description: Only the log lines that look like errors or warnings from the containers picked in LOG CONTAINER. The quickest way to see whether anything is complaining right now.

panels.title: Verbose // $logcontainer ∩ $logq
panels.description: Every log line from the containers picked in LOG CONTAINER, narrowed by the LOG FILTER box (a regular expression). Use FORENSICS to tie lines to one specific request.
